register.labelZh: STRING 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: string along with somebody 可以自然地詢問自己能否跟別人一起前往某處。；string out 可以描述步行者、跑手、車輛或船隻散開成長長一列。；string together 可以描述某人如何把詞語、句子或想法連接起來。；string somebody along 表示令某人一直抱有虛假希望;string something out 則表示把事情拖得太久。；string something up 適合用來談論橫額、燈飾、照片和派對裝飾。
register.summaryEn: String along with somebody is a casual way to ask whether you may accompany them somewhere. String out can describe walkers, runners, vehicles or boats spreading into a long line. String together is useful when describing how someone connects words, sentences or ideas. String somebody along describes misleading someone, while string something out describes making an event continue for too long. String something up is useful when talking about banners, lights, photographs and party decorations.
